scope: Day 5 versioned operator command/status contract and read-only current mission snapshot
source_state: Local Day 4 and Day 5 working tree identified by hashes; no Day 5 commit or push performed

commands.versioned: ~/command_json: strict instruction/text, choose/option and stop envelopes
commands.qos: Reliable, volatile, keep-last depth 1 for both inputs
commands.deduplication: No client command IDs or durable retry guarantee; remains a separate roadmap item

implementation.status: Existing fields retained; adds schema_version, type, controller instance_id and monotonic event sequence

snapshot.service: ~/get_mission_snapshot: std_srvs/srv/Trigger; success indicates a completed read
snapshot.clock: Steady clock, independent of paused simulated ROS time
snapshot.consistency: State copied under the controller RLock; reads neither poll nor dispatch commands
snapshot.retention: Most recent mission-state outcome in memory for controller lifetime; rejected commands do not replace it
snapshot.restart: New instance ID and idle state; no command or mission replay; no post-crash Nav2 ownership reconciliation

regressions_fixed: Single-goal choices now expire on poll and are cleared visibly on stop
Choice selection rejects the exact expiry boundary consistently with polling
Arrival verification now has an explicit status for snapshot readers

tests.execution: Outside filesystem sandbox after targeted storage-backed runs stalled inside it

ros_check.source_mounts: Current src/placecell and simulation/scripts mounted read-only; existing image not rebuilt

result.scope: Real ROS topics, QoS and services; scripted navigation

limitations: No paid API calls; no live model-quality qualification.
